name: rstudio-ai-backend
description: RStudio AI backend powered by the Pi coding agent. Bridges the RStudio chat UI to a Pi Agent session with R kernel tools. Replaces the OpenAI-compatible bridge; no Posit account, sign-in, or telemetry is involved.

scripts.postinstall: echo 'Pi Agent installed. The Pi binary is at ./node_modules/.bin/pi'
